description: This file declares API functions and macros for managing retries of notification subscription messages within a software system. It includes function prototypes for initializing, stopping, adding, removing, and deleting retry entries, as well as a macro for a special subscription instance. The header also includes copyright information and include guards.

methods.name: SUBS_RETRY_Add
methods.description: Adds a new retry entry with specified parameters for message and subscription details.

methods.name: SUBS_RETRY_AddWithFds
methods.description: Adds a new retry entry with file descriptor passing support (experimental).

methods.name: SUBS_RETRY_Remove
methods.description: Removes a retry entry identified by message and subscription IDs.

methods.name: SUBS_RETRY_Delete
methods.description: Deletes a retry entry based on instance number.
